status_definitions.validated_engineering: Deterministic implementation claim supported by tests or a controlled gate.
status_definitions.candidate_automated: Completed automated research evidence with explicit validity limits; not independently human validated.
status_definitions.not_established: The current study cannot support this claim.
status_definitions.superseded: Historical artifact retained only for forensic comparison and not citable as current evidence.

artifact_policy.current_results: Only entries in this registry and the comprehensive 2026-08-03 report are current evidence.
artifact_policy.row_level_requirement: Every reported aggregate must be reproducible from saved row-level predictions.
artifact_policy.error_policy: Execution errors remain unscored and visible; they are never replaced by a default prediction.
artifact_policy.legacy_outputs: Older output directories are superseded even when retained on disk.

entries.scope: Deterministic inputs, three deletion seeds, random/clustered modes, logged triples, companion declarations, and file hashes.

entries.result: 101 tests pass; NUSMods 0.3476 and CoDEx 0.2953 shuffled prediction-change rates both pass the 0.20 gate; RMIT shuffle/empty accuracy drops are 0.424/0.515.

Across all four generator/detector pairs, random-deletion binary FCR reaches 0.963-0.991 at 20% retention while declared FCR is 0 under mechanical labels. Oracle and extracted-atom Stage 4 accuracy are 1.0.
entries.validity_limit: Questions, declarations, and gold are graph/researcher derived; no human validation; one stochastic answer run per generator condition.

entries.result: Azure/Gemma oracle-context tri-state accuracy changes from 0.920/0.873 at full retention to 0.643/0.367 at random 20%, versus binary-collapse accuracy 0.247/0.217. MiniCheck cannot express Not-in-KG; title-only NIL linking remains a major limitation.
entries.validity_limit: Flat context is selected from known expected triples and is not an end-to-end retriever.

entries.result: Full-context expected-triple F1 is 0.788 Azure and 0.678 Gemma; random 20% binary FCR is 0.953/0.987 and declared FCR is 0 under mechanical labels.
entries.validity_limit: RMIT contains 50 graph entities and 50 long-form questions.

entries.result: Random-sample Azure/Gemma accuracy is 0.998/0.994 on NUSMods, 0.848/0.798 on CoDEx, and 0.604/0.590 on FactKG; full RMIT accuracy is 0.970/0.750. All cells have zero harness failures.
entries.validity_limit: FactKG is forced binary and ordered by reasoning type; RMIT public claims remain synthetic; public intervals are row-level rather than entity-clustered. Four earlier Azure CoDEx/FactKG cells predate start-time hash capture; all local cells and affected Azure NUSMods/RMIT reruns contain code identity.

entries.supported_claim: Controlled deletion shows that binary missing-evidence handling creates a steep false-contradiction curve and that explicit relation completeness metadata implements consistent tri-state semantics.

human_validation.consequence: Research entries remain candidate_automated and cannot support an independent efficacy or journal-ready claim.

superseded_policy: All registry-v1 studies, dated pilots, draft papers, and duplicate status documents are superseded and recoverable through Git history.
